An '''identity bracelet''' was mandatory for all citizens living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Deysum III]]. Visitors were issued identity bracelets on arrival to the planet for the duration of their visit.<ref name="Changing">{{WEGCite|story=Changing the Balance|book=Star Wars Gamemaster Kit}}</ref>
